svg.font-family: -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Deep navy, obsidian, plum, petrol, espresso, slate-indigo — each as a live mini app preview.

g.text: The big dark gradient block is what lives on the KPI hero and primary buttons. Canvas (right half) is always light.
My top picks for a professional HRMS:
6 (Deep Navy) — most universally trusted, reads "enterprise"; 9 (Petrol) — distinctive + calm, rare in HRTech; 8 (Obsidian) — timeless luxury.
Tell me a number (or "6 with lavender accent") and I'll wire it as a toggle-able theme without touching your blue brand.
